impact.attacker_capability: Cause a compiler or CI pipeline processing contributor-controlled Tact source to terminate with a maximum-call-stack error.
impact.security_effect: Denial of service of a Tact compiler invocation or CI build that compiles the cyclic project.

causal_trace.summary: Contributor-controlled Tact source can define a trait cycle, exemplified by traits A and B inheriting each other and a contract using A.

processType is meant to track types active in dependency resolution with a processing set, but the reviewed implementation calls processing.has(name) where it should add the current name. Consequently, an active recursion-stack marker is never established.

For each dependency whose traits include the current name, processType recursively invokes itself. In the mutual-trait cycle, the circular-dependency guard cannot observe an active type and resolution repeatedly re-enters the cycle.
Unbounded resolver recursion exhausts the JavaScript call stack, producing “Maximum call stack size exceeded” and crashing compilation of the supplied project.

failure.operation: Recursive processType traversal of mutually dependent traits until JavaScript stack exhaustion

primary_invariant.statement: Before resolving a type's dependencies, processType must mark that type active in the processing set; a traversal that encounters an active type must identify a circular dependency rather than recurse.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The implementation checks membership twice instead of inserting the current name, leaving the processing set without the active type during recursive dependency traversal.

raw_refs.role: primary audit finding and fix-review evidence

quality.review_notes: The public audit report supplies the trigger, reviewed resolver behavior, crash observable, and a fix-review statement that commit d12cf94 adds the current trait and a circular-dependency test. The bundle does not include an immutable upstream patch or test artifact, an execution log, or an affected release/commit range; the oracle is report-described and no test pass/fail is claimed.

remediation.invariant_restored: Add the current trait to the processing list before dependency traversal, retain removal after completion, and reject the detected circular dependency.

state_context.attacker_state_setup: Provide two traits that mutually inherit and a contract that uses one of them.
data_structure_invariants: The processing set represents types on the current recursive resolution path.
A type encountered while present in the processing set is a circular dependency.
state_context.state_machine: Dependency resolution should add a type to the active processing set before recursively resolving dependencies, then remove it after completion; encountering an active type signals a cycle.

affected_versions_or_commits.value: Version/commit of the vulnerable audited state is not identified in the supplied bundle.

oracle.expected_negative: With active-trait insertion and circular-dependency detection, the same input is detected as circular rather than recursively exhausting the call stack.
oracle.expected_positive: Compiling the report's mutually dependent trait program on the vulnerable resolver produces “Maximum call stack size exceeded.”
